stops.name: Noiraigue
stops.quote: The tour starts at the historical railway station in Noraigue.
stops.english: The tour starts at the historical railway station in Noraigue.

stops.name: River Areuse
stops.quote: Now you get to experience the sunny side of cycling: sit on the bike, step on the pedals and off you go for a short trip along the River Areuse through the Val de Travers.

stops.name: Creux du Van
stops.quote: Around 300 m from Creux du Van, park your e-bike at the restaurant Le Soliat and continue the rest of the way on foot.

stops.name: Lake Neuenburg
stops.quote: Encompassing 15.5 square kilometres of area and offering superb views of Lake Neuenburg, this is the largest natural reserve in the Canton of Neuchâtel.

stops.name: Couvet
stops.quote: After a reviving snack, enjoy a relaxed cycle through the tranquil landscape via Couvet back to the starting point in Noiraigue.
